newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Transener gets $210 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Transener gets $210 mln loan.

text.p: Argentine utility company Transener SA said Tuesday it has obtained a $210 million three-year loan from the Morgan Guarany Trust Company.
The loan, which can be paid back before maturity, will be used to finance Transener's take over of energy transmission company Eseba.
Transener won a 95-year concession to operate Eseba in a tender on July 18 with a $220 million bid. Eseba is now going to operate as Transba SA and will be transferred to Transener on August 1.
No further terms of the loan were given.
